title: customfire
description: Client side mod to customize the fire texture to your liking
body:
Custom Fire is a lightweight client-side Minecraft mod that gives you complete control over the appearance of fire.

Customize your fire with different colors, unique textures, and visual styles to match your resource pack, PvP setup, or personal preference. Whether you want a clean blue flame, a realistic campfire look, or a completely custom design, Custom Fire makes it simple.
